summary: This article provides a detailed review of the Business Green Rewards Card from American Express, highlighting its features, benefits, and drawbacks. title: General Dynamics wins $54 million Army contract

The contract is a cost-plus-fixed-fee, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity agreement covering original equipment manufacturer support. The work, for which General Dynamics was the sole bidder, is estimated to be completed by August 24, 2031.
